event.richCustomer: A patron with more money than sense took a liking to {actor} and left a tip to match.
event.collector: A collector recognised the trappings of the trade and paid well to have {actor}'s eye on a piece.
event.skimmed: Nobody was watching closely enough. {actor} left with rather more than the job paid for.
event.shakedown: Someone decided, on seeing {actor}, that paying up was cheaper than not.
event.headhunted: Word got around. Someone slipped {actor} a card and a retainer to go with it.
event.quietShift: The shift ran short and the pay did not. Nobody complained.
event.apprentice: {actor} spent half the shift showing a new hire the trade, and learned it better for the telling.
event.ambush: The shift ended in an alley, and the alley was not empty.
event.raid: Somebody came for the stock, and {actor} was the only one standing between them and it.
event.difficultCustomer: A customer took against {actor} on sight and made a show of it in front of the manager.
event.inspection: An inspector turned up asking questions {actor} would rather not have been asked.
event.nearMiss: Something heavy came down where {actor} had been standing a moment before.
event.backlash: The working turned back on {actor} halfway through and had to be wrestled shut.
event.docked: The damage came out of {actor}'s pay, as the damage tends to.

shift.benched: {actor} finished at {job} with {amount}€, and waits with the inactive members.
